page.overview:
What is Deep Sea Scale?

Deep Sea Scale is an item introduced in Generation III.

The Deep Sea Scale raises Clamperl's Special Defense if held by it. The Deep Sea Scale is also an evolution item, evolving Clamperl into Gorebyss if it is traded while holding the item. The Deep Sea Scale has a counterpart named Deep Sea Tooth, which evolves Clamperl into Huntail instead.

Although the Deep Sea Tooth does not appear in , both games still have unique flavor text of it.
